column1: # URI-reference = URI / relative-ref, so a reference may be relative and the
# format accepts the scheme-less forms. Only a forbidden character makes it
# reject. The official suite's optional/format/uri-reference.json carries the
# network-path, absolute-path, relative-path, and fragment-only forms; what it
# leaves open are the query-only and empty references. The RFC 3986 §5.4
# reference inputs stay in vectors_test.go, where they run verbatim and in order
# against this format; the §5.4 resolution targets run there against uri.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.

column3: an absolute URI is a reference
the empty reference resolves to the base
